title: Emerald City Pilates

services.name: Emerald City Pilates
services.desc: Our memberships give you consistent sessions at better rates, guaranteed time slots with your instructor, and priority access to workshops and events. You wouldn't work with a personal trainer once a month and expect results. Same goes here. Consistency is how you strengthen what's weak, fix what's broken, and understand how your body works. Your guaranteed time slot means Pilates becomes part of your routine - not something you squeeze in when there's space. That's how people go from "my back hurts all the time" to "wait, when did that stop hurting?" Start with our New Client Special to see if we're the right fit. After your three sessions, we'll help you choose the membership that works
